_meta.title: DRAFT ASM titration rules - Aim 2 (pediatric epilepsy medication assistant)
_meta.status: UNVERIFIED DRAFT. Every clinical value requires verification and correction by Dr. Barbour (PI) before any clinical use. Provided only to make the rule-setting session efficient - 'something to edit rather than a blank page.'
_meta.scope: Ages 2-17, core titration only (dose bands, ceilings, uptitration step/interval, formulations). Interactions/monitoring summarized briefly only where they drive titration (e.g. lamotrigine+valproate).
_meta.provenance: Formulations from RxNorm (pulled 2026-06-17). Dose bands compiled from FDA prescribing information / standard pediatric references (per-drug 'source' keys map to _sources).
_meta.schema_note: EXTENDED vs engine_core/asm_rules.py DoseBand. Weight-based bands use *_mg_per_kg_per_day fields (most pediatric ASM dosing is weight-based and the current absolute-mg DoseBand cannot represent it). Fixed/weight-band bands ALSO include the engine's existing absolute fields (dose_range_max_mg_per_day, max_daily_mg, standard_uptitration_step_mg, standard_uptitration_interval_weeks) so they load and run in the UNMODIFIED engine. See PROPOSED_engine_patch.md to make weight-based bands produce schedules.
_meta.openfda_currency_note: openFDA label dataset updates were reported suspended in 2025; values were cross-checked against current FDA PI pages where possible but still require clinician verification.
hard_rules: Clinical decisions remain RULE-BASED and clinician-defined; this file is data, not logic.
No value here is authoritative until the PI verifies it (verified=false on every band).
Confidential: keep in the study folder only.

_sources.rxnorm: RxNorm SCD concepts, RxNav REST API (rxnav.nlm.nih.gov/REST/rxcui/<id>/related?tty=SCD), US NLM. Pulled 2026-06-17.
_sources.keppra: FDA Keppra (levetiracetam) Prescribing Information (accessdata.fda.gov 021035s115/021505s053, 2024); plan-doc draft.
_sources.lamictal: FDA Lamictal (lamotrigine) Prescribing Information; Drugs.com lamotrigine dosage (pediatric mg/kg titration, valproate 50% reduction).
_sources.briviact: FDA Briviact (brivaracetam) Prescribing Information (accessdata.fda.gov 205836s017, 2025) - weight-based peds 4-<16y.
_sources.vimpat: FDA Vimpat (lacosamide) Prescribing Information (accessdata.fda.gov 022253s049, 2021; UCB PI) - weight-based peds.
_sources.onfi: FDA Onfi (clobazam) Prescribing Information (accessdata.fda.gov 203993s005, 2016) - weight-band (<=30 vs >30 kg).
_sources.zarontin: FDA Zarontin (ethosuximide) Prescribing Information (accessdata.fda.gov 012380s031, 2009) - absence only, >=3y.
_sources.zonegran: FDA Zonegran (zonisamide) PI (>=16y, adjunctive focal); Zonisade oral susp PI (accessdata 214273, 2022); pediatric use is OFF-LABEL (Epilepsy Foundation; pediatric literature).

levetiracetam.fda_pediatric_age: focal from 1 month; myoclonic (JME) from 12y; PGTC from 6y

dose_bands.label: Children/adolescents 2-17y, weight-based
dose_bands.clinician_note: Oral solution recommended if <=20 kg. Renally cleared (study excludes renal impairment). Watch behavioral/mood effects.

levetiracetam.key_safety: Behavioral/psychiatric effects (irritability, mood). Renal clearance -> reduce in renal impairment (excluded from study).

lamotrigine.SAFETY_PRIORITY: BOXED WARNING: serious rash (SJS/TEN). Risk increased by concomitant valproate, by exceeding the initial dose, and by escalating faster than recommended. Slow titration is essential. Titration is CONCOMITANT-MED DEPENDENT (see 3 regimens).

dose_bands.label: 2-17y, WITHOUT valproate and WITHOUT enzyme inducer
dose_bands.clinician_note: Wk1-2: 0.3 mg/kg/day; wk3-4: 0.6 mg/kg/day; then +0.6 mg/kg/day q1-2wk. Target 4.5-7.5 mg/kg/day (cap ~300 mg/day adjunctive).

dose_bands.label: 2-17y, WITH valproate (much lower & slower)
dose_bands.clinician_note: VALPROATE INTERACTION: ~50% reduction at each step. Wk1-2: 0.15 mg/kg/day; wk3-4: 0.3 mg/kg/day; then +0.3 mg/kg/day q1-2wk. Target 1-5 mg/kg/day (<=2.5 mg/kg/day or 200 mg/day). HIGHEST rash risk.

dose_bands.label: 2-17y, WITH enzyme inducer (carbamazepine/phenytoin/phenobarbital/primidone) and WITHOUT valproate
dose_bands.clinician_note: Wk1-2: 0.6 mg/kg/day; wk3-4: 1.2 mg/kg/day; then +1.2 mg/kg/day q1-2wk. Target 5-15 mg/kg/day (cap ~400 mg/day).

lamotrigine.key_safety: SJS/TEN boxed warning (esp first 8 weeks). Do NOT exceed initial dose or recommended escalation rate.
lamotrigine.key_interactions: Valproate raises lamotrigine levels & rash risk (MAJOR -> lower/slower). Enzyme inducers lower levels (higher/faster). Engine must select the correct regimen from concomitant meds.

dose_bands.label: 2-17y, weight-based (adjunctive)
dose_bands.clinician_note: Start ~1-3 mg/kg/day (=25 mg) nightly wk1; increase 1-3 mg/kg/day q1-2wk. Target 5-9 mg/kg/day. step shown = mid of 1-3 mg/kg/day range - confirm.

topiramate.key_safety: Metabolic acidosis; oligohidrosis/hyperthermia (esp children, hot weather); cognitive/word-finding; weight loss; nephrolithiasis.
topiramate.key_interactions: Levels lowered by enzyme inducers (carbamazepine, phenytoin).

dose_bands.label: 2-17y, weight-based (adjunctive)
dose_bands.clinician_note: Start 8-10 mg/kg/day (<=600 mg/day); reach maintenance over 2-4 wks; target 30-46 mg/kg/day by weight tier; max 60 mg/kg/day. Label also gives weight-tiered absolute targets (e.g. 20-29kg ~900 mg/day; 29.1-39kg ~1200; >39kg ~1800).

oxcarbazepine.key_safety: Hyponatremia (check sodium); HLA-B*1502 -> SJS risk (screen patients of Asian ancestry).
oxcarbazepine.key_interactions: Dose-dependent enzyme induction; lowers hormonal contraceptives; interacts with lamotrigine/phenytoin.

dose_bands.label: 2 to <6y, weight-based
dose_bands.clinician_note: Start 10-20 mg/kg/day divided BID-TID (QID for suspension); increase weekly; maintenance generally <35 mg/kg/day.

dose_bands.label: 6 to 12y, fixed-mg titration
dose_bands.clinician_note: Start 100 mg BID; add up to 100 mg/day weekly; target 400-800 mg/day; max 1000 mg/day (6-12y).

dose_bands.label: >12 to 17y, fixed-mg titration
dose_bands.clinician_note: Start 200 mg BID; add up to 200 mg/day weekly; target 800-1200 mg/day; max 1000 mg/day (12-15y), 1200 mg/day (15-17y).

carbamazepine.key_safety: HLA-B*1502 (SJS/TEN; screen Asian ancestry); AUTOINDUCTION (levels fall ~wk3-5, may need re-titration); hyponatremia; rare aplastic anemia/agranulocytosis.
carbamazepine.key_interactions: Strong enzyme inducer (lowers lamotrigine, oral contraceptives, many drugs); levels raised by CYP3A4 inhibitors.

dose_bands.label: 2-17y, weight-based
dose_bands.clinician_note: Start 10-15 mg/kg/day; increase 5-10 mg/kg/week; max 60 mg/kg/day. step/start shown = midpoints - confirm. Divalproex (Depakote) is ~1:1 valproic acid equivalent.

valproic_acid.key_safety: BOXED: hepatotoxicity (highest <2y & polytherapy; <2y excluded by study age >=2), pancreatitis, teratogenicity (counsel patients of childbearing potential). Also thrombocytopenia, hyperammonemia.
valproic_acid.key_interactions: Raises lamotrigine levels & rash risk (MAJOR). Levels affected by enzyme inducers/carbapenems.

dose_bands.label: <=30 kg body weight
dose_bands.clinician_note: <=30kg: 5 mg/day -> day8 10 mg/day -> day15 20 mg/day (max 20). Doses >5 mg/day are divided BID.

dose_bands.label: >30 kg body weight
dose_bands.clinician_note: >30kg: 10 mg/day -> day8 20 mg/day -> day15 40 mg/day (max 40).

clobazam.key_safety: Benzodiazepine: somnolence/sedation, physical dependence & withdrawal (TAPER, do not stop abruptly). CYP2C19 poor metabolizers -> lower dose. SJS/TEN reported (esp first 8 weeks).

dose_bands.label: 11 to <30 kg, weight-based
dose_bands.clinician_note: Start ~2 mg/kg/day; titrate <= once/week; maintenance 6-12 mg/kg/day (<30kg).

dose_bands.label: 30 to <50 kg, weight-based
dose_bands.clinician_note: Start ~2 mg/kg/day; maintenance 4-8 mg/kg/day (30-<50kg).

dose_bands.label: >=50 kg, fixed-mg
dose_bands.clinician_note: >=50kg: start 50 mg BID (100 mg/day); maintenance 200-400 mg/day. Confirm max (label notes 300 mg/day recommended in some peds contexts vs 400 adult).

lacosamide.key_safety: PR-interval prolongation (caution with cardiac conduction problems/concomitant PR-prolonging drugs); dizziness/ataxia. Schedule V.
lacosamide.key_interactions: Additive PR prolongation; modest with strong CYP inducers.

dose_bands.label: 11 to <20 kg, weight-based
dose_bands.clinician_note: Weight-based BID. 11-<20kg: 0.5-2.5 mg/kg BID (1-5 mg/kg/day); typical start ~1.25 mg/kg BID. Can start at target (no forced titration).

dose_bands.label: 20 to <50 kg, weight-based
dose_bands.clinician_note: 20-<50kg: 0.5-2 mg/kg BID (1-4 mg/kg/day); typical start 1 mg/kg BID.

dose_bands.label: >=50 kg, fixed-mg
dose_bands.clinician_note: >=50kg: start 50 mg BID (100 mg/day); range 25-100 mg BID (50-200 mg/day). No titration required.

brivaracetam.key_safety: Behavioral/psychiatric reactions (irritability, anxiety). Schedule V. Reduce in hepatic impairment (excluded from study).
brivaracetam.key_interactions: Levels lowered by strong enzyme inducers (carbamazepine, phenytoin); rifampin lowers levels.

indications: adjunctive focal (FDA >=16y); pediatric use is OFF-LABEL
zonisamide.fda_pediatric_age: >=16y (Zonegran). Pediatric <16y is OFF-LABEL (Zonisade oral suspension has a partial-seizure indication - confirm pediatric age).

dose_bands.label: 2 to <16y, weight-based (OFF-LABEL)
dose_bands.clinician_note: OFF-LABEL <16y. Start 1-2 mg/kg/day; increase 1-2 mg/kg/day q1-2wk; target 4-8 mg/kg/day; max ~12 mg/kg/day or 600 mg/day. Long half-life (QD-BID).

dose_bands.label: 16-17y (FDA-approved range)
dose_bands.clinician_note: 16y+: 100 mg/day start; increase by 100 mg/day q>=2wk; max 600 mg/day.

zonisamide.key_safety: OFF-LABEL in children. Sulfonamide (avoid if sulfa allergy). Oligohidrosis/hyperthermia in children (IMPORTANT - heat illness). Metabolic acidosis; renal stones; long half-life.

indications: absence (petit mal) ONLY - no efficacy for focal/GTC

dose_bands.label: 3 to 6y, fixed-mg start
dose_bands.clinician_note: 3-6y: start 250 mg/day; increase 250 mg every 4-7 days; optimal ~20 mg/kg/day; max 1500 mg/day.

dose_bands.label: >6 to 17y, fixed-mg start
dose_bands.clinician_note: >6y: start 500 mg/day; increase 250 mg every 4-7 days; optimal ~20 mg/kg/day; max 1500 mg/day.

ethosuximide.key_safety: ABSENCE ONLY - does not protect against GTC/focal (if mixed epilepsy, a broad-spectrum agent is needed). Rare blood dyscrasias; SJS reported; GI upset.
